siteId.description: The site the parcel arrived at.

lines.description: Every line of the parcel; each is MATCHED or UNEXPECTED, never anything else.

kind.description:
How a received line relates to an RMA. `MATCHED` lines carry the rmaId
they match; `UNEXPECTED` lines have none and raise
`UnexpectedReturnReceived`. There is no third state.
kind.title: LineKind

rmaId.description: Required when kind is MATCHED; must be absent (or null) when kind is UNEXPECTED.
